text:
```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install setuptools wheel
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file will test your repository on multiple Python versions specified in the `matrix` section. It sets up each job to use a different Python version, installs the required dependencies, and runs the tests using `pytest`. This ensures that your project works correctly across the specified Python versions.
